hero.h1: How to Save Everyone in Directive 8020
hero.intro: A step-by-step guide to keeping all 5 playable characters alive and unlocking the true ending — “Eisele the Humanitarian.”

warning.heading: ❌ Carter and Simms Cannot Be Saved — This Is By Design
warning.before: Many players get confused trying to save Carter and Simms. Please understand: their deaths are scripted story events. No matter what choices you make, both characters will die in their pre-determined scenes.
warning.strong: Do not waste time trying to change this.
warning.after: Focus on protecting the 5 playable characters: Young, Stafford, Eisele, Cernan, and Cooper.

howTo.name: How to Save Everyone in Directive 8020
howTo.description: Step-by-step guide to achieving the true ending with all 5 playable characters surviving.

steps.name: Accept that Carter and Simms cannot be saved
steps.text: Carter and Simms die in scripted events during Episode 1. No choices can prevent this — it is by design. Focus on the 5 playable characters.

steps.name: Episode 1 — Authorize weapon use
steps.text: In the Crew Quarters Turning Point, choose "Authorize use of weapon" to open combat options later. Choose "Honor" then "Consider" when dealing with Stafford.

steps.name: Episode 2 — Trust Stafford and allow research
steps.text: Choose "Trust Stafford" on the Command Deck and "Allow study" in the Science Lab. Investigate the distress call to unlock a collectible.

steps.name: Episode 3 — Report immediately, side with Eisele
steps.text: As Cernan, choose "Report immediately" in the Cargo Bay. Choose "Contain and study" in the Containment Lab. Side with Eisele in the Briefing Room debate.

steps.name: Episode 4 — Follow Cooper, confirm reactor kill
steps.text: Follow Cooper's directions in the maintenance tunnels. After the creature falls into the reactor, confirm it's dead and report back.

steps.name: Episode 5 — Prepare sedative, save Mitchell & Anders
steps.text: MISSABLE: Prepare the sedative in the lab before leaving. Rescue both Mitchell and Anders from the fire. Encourage Stafford to unlock The Father Destiny.

steps.name: Episode 6 — Trust the newcomer Eisele, turn RIGHT outside
steps.text: The most critical choice: trust the NEWCOMER Eisele. Turn RIGHT at the outdoor junction (not into the cave). Escape the reactor before meltdown.

steps.name: Episodes 7-8 — Expose the clone program
steps.text: Eisele must choose "Expose the clone program" to unlock the true ending. This broadcasts the truth to humanity and ends Cycle 13.

e5-sedative.text: ⚠ MISSABLE — The game does not prompt this. Actively explore the lab before leaving.
e5-sedative.tip: Interact with the lab equipment to prepare the sedative.

e6-two-eiseles.text: 🔑 Most Critical Choice in the Game
e6-two-eiseles.tip: Watch their fear animations when the gun is pointed at them. The newcomer's reaction looks genuinely human and scared. The other's movements are subtly unnatural.

e6-outdoor-junction.text: ⚠ The game does NOT warn you this is a point of no return. Once you enter the cave, you cannot go back.

e7-eisele-final.text: ⭐ Unlocks True Ending — Eisele the Humanitarian

destinies.heading: Destinies Unlock Checklist
destinies.intro: Each playable character has a Destiny that unlocks during specific moments. Unlocking these is required for the best ending route.

rows.how: Make compassionate choices throughout the game. Choose Honor when given the option in Episode 1.
Encourage him during his breakdown in Episode 5. Say "Never forget why you started."
Choose to expose the clone program in Episode 8. Requires all prior Eisele-positive choices.
Choose to protect the scientific data in Episode 8 instead of exposing the truth.
Make choices that prioritize Cernan's safety in Episodes 3 and 7.
Authorize weapons in Episode 1 and send backup in Episode 5.

sections.heading: Confirmed replay rules
sections.text: Explorer allows Turning Points during the story. Survivor commits you to decisions on the first run and unlocks Turning Points if you reach the ending. These rules do not prove the requirements of a particular ending or password.

sections.heading: Before route advice is restored
sections.text: A reproducible record must identify the platform, game version, prior choices, actual prompt and observed result. The old details are retained for editorial review but are not published as current instructions. Use the official sources below and the verified controls guide while this review is pending.
